# Beckon Billing API client (PHP)

> Official, open-source PHP client (`composer require beckonbilling/api-client`)
> for the Beckon Billing REST API v1. A thin, typed PSR-18 wrapper over nine
> entities - seven writable (customers, article categories, articles, quotes, orders,
> outbound invoices, recurring invoices) and two read-only (units, document
> templates) - plus user-token auth. PHP >=8.2, PSR-4, MIT.

Key facts for an assistant:
- Construct: `new BeckonBilling\ApiClient\Client(['token' => 'bbp_...', 'base_uri' => 'https://portal.beckonbilling.com', 'organisation' => 'uuid'])`.
- Entities via properties: `$client->customers`, `->articleCategories`, `->articles`, `->units`, `->documentTemplates`, `->quotes`, `->orders`, `->outboundInvoices`, `->recurringInvoices`, `->auth`.
- CRUD: `list()`, `autoPaging()`, `get()`, `create()`, `update()`, `delete()`. Lists return a `Collection` (`data`/`total`/`limit`/`offset`). Creating answers 201.
- `units` and `documentTemplates` are read-only (list/get); writing to them throws `\LogicException`.
- Actions: quotes `issue/send/sendResult/pdf` (`convert` is deprecated - see the gap below); invoices `issue/send/cancel/setPaid/pdf`. Articles also carry variants: `variants/createVariant/updateVariant`.
- Errors: typed subclasses of `ApiException`; branch on `getErrorKey()`. Capabilities `send`/`bank` gate email/money actions.
- Orders (`->orders`, feature `orders`): the Auftrag between a quote and its invoices, own number range `A-{YYYY}-{NNNN}`, plain CRUD, filters `status`/`customer_id`/`q`. Create needs `label` + `customer_id` (422 `label_required` / `order_customer_required`). Deliberately WITHOUT the internal rate and the profitability block (`internal_hourly_rate`, `resolved_internal_rate`, `resolved_hourly_rate`, `financials` - sent on a write they are ignored, not refused) and WITHOUT sub-routes (`/orders/{id}/<anything>` = 404). `status`, `start_date` and `settled_at` are read-only. Delete answers 409 `order_has_issued_invoices` when an issued invoice hangs off it.
- **Known gap, smaller since 0.15.0: you can read the order, you still cannot invoice it here.** `POST /quotes/{id}/convert` was retired (410 `quote_conversion_moved`); `quotes->convert()` throws a local `GoneException` instead of making a request. The order a won quote became is now reachable (`Quote::$order` carries its id), but the invoice-from-order action is portal-only.
- A quote is immutable once issued: `update()` with content against an `issued` quote is 409 `quote_issued_locked`, against `won`/`converted` it is 409 `quote_closed_locked` (a pure status change to `won`/`lost` on an `issued` quote is exempt). Only a `draft` can be `delete()`d (409 `quote_closed_undeletable` otherwise). Setting `status: 'lost'` needs `lost_reason` (`price`/`timing`/`competitor`/`no_need`, else 422 `lost_reason_required`); setting `status: 'won'` may create an order (`Quote.order`, `{id,label,public_index}`) and send its confirmation (`order_confirmation` on the response). Re-sending a `won` quote is refused (409 `quote_won_not_reopenable`); a `lost` one reopens. Separately, `positions` can 409 `quote_positions_locked_by_billing` on ANY status - including `draft`/`lost`/`revising` - once an order has invoiced one of them; echoing back what you read is always safe.
- Terms: every document carries TWO texts, `terms_text` and `payment_terms_text`, printed in that order. Load a preset with the write-only `document_template_id` (the old `document_term_id` answers 422 `document_term_id_retired`); browse them via `$client->documentTemplates->list(['kind' => 'quote'|'invoice'])` - the kind is `invoice`, not `outbound_invoice`.
- Staged billing (deposit/final) is READ-only knowledge now: an existing invoice reports `invoice_scope` and names its quote in `quote_id`. A deposit and a final invoice ALREADY sum - the final one carries negative deduction lines - so never add them as if each were the whole amount. Creating a new staged invoice from a quote is no longer possible through this API (see the gap above).
- Units are a FIXED system catalogue of 31 entries (`key` plus printed forms per language), identical for every organisation and readable with any valid token. An ARTICLE's `unit` must be a key (`piece`, `hour`, `month`) and an unknown one answers 422 `unit_unknown` - a printed form is not a key. A POSITION carries both: send the key in `unit_key` (printed wordings move, keys do not), while `unit` holds the printed wording snapshotted on that line and is never refused. When both are sent and name the SAME unit the stored wording is kept verbatim, so echoing a document's own positions never rewrites it; a key naming a different unit wins. An empty `unit_key` means "no catalogue key for this line", not "no unit".
- Traps worth knowing: `due_days` (not `due_date`) sets an invoice's payment term; an invoice's `terms_text` is empty by default, so rendering only that field prints nothing; `issue()` reports `send_error` and `payment_link_error` on a 200; `cancel()` returns the credit note; `language` on a quote/invoice/recurring invoice is stamped from the linked customer's own `language` field, NOT recomputed from `recipient.country` (country only decides what the CUSTOMER is stamped with on save: DE for DE/AT/CH, else EN); `OutboundInvoice.dunning_mode` is read-only and portal-set, with `dunning_excluded` as its resolved boolean and `source` as what `auto` resolves against.
- A recurring invoice carries its attachments TWICE: `document_ids` (the one place this API shows internal INTEGER ids) and `document_uuids` (the same list by uuid). Both are readable and writable; `document_uuids` wins when both are sent, and is the one to write - a foreign or unknown `document_ids` entry is dropped in silence, not refused. Which of the two survives long-term is still open; neither is deprecated and no date is promised.
